project.title: Atlanta-Memphis Corridor
project.about: The proposed route would run between Atlanta and Memphis with stops in Chattanooga and Nashville, one of the largest cities with no passenger rail.

project.title: Atlanta to Savannah Corridor
project.about: Georgia's first state-supported route would connect inland Atlanta to coastal Savannah by way of Athens/Augusta or Macon.

project.title: TCMC Service Expansion via La Crosse
project.about: In 2024, the Borealis route opened as Minnesota's first state-supported service to supplement the daily Empire Builder along the Twin Cities-Milwaukee-Chicago corridor.

project.title: Milwaukee-Madison-Eau Claire-Twin Cities Corridor
project.about: A new service pattern for the Borealis route would extend service from the Twin Cities-Milwaukee-Chicago corridor to Madison and Eau Claire.

project.title: Boston and Albany Corridor
project.about: Most of Massachusetts' largest population centers sit along a straight line spanning the length of the state. A new state-supported route would supplement the existing Lake Shore Limited, increasing service from one to as many as eight daily round trips.

project.title: Capitol Corridor
project.about: The Capitol Corridor route would be extended south to Salinas and northeast into Reno/Sparks, Nevada with a branch originating in the North Bay.

project.title: Hannibal Extension
project.about: The existing Chicago-Quincy corridor would be extended across the border to Hannibal, Missouri.

project.title: Charlotte to Kings Mountain Corridor
project.about: This project aims to improve capacity along a small stretch of the Charlotte-Atlanta corridor by adding infill stations and a new service reaching as far as Kings Mountain.

project.title: Louisville-Indianapolis Passenger Rail Corridor
project.about: Louisville has not seen intercity rail service since Amtrak's Kentucky Cardinal was discontinued in the Early 2000s. A restoration of this route would connect the city to Indianapolis and Chicago while supplementing the Cardinal between the two.

project.title: Chicago to Quad Cities Service Extension
project.about: The Quad Cities project aims to reactivate the Rock Island line with the goal of supporting Amtrak service to Moline.

project.title: Peoria to Chicago Passenger Rail Service
project.about: A short regional route would connect Chicago and its suburbs to Peoria, Illinois.

project.title: Chicago, Fort Wayne, Columbus, and Pittsburgh
project.about: This proposal aims to reinstate service on an existing alignment, bringing the first Amtrak service to Columbus and Fort Wayne.

project.title: 3C&D Corridor
project.about: The 3C&D will be Ohio's flagship state-supported passenger service connecting the three largest cities, Dayton, and Cleveland's Airport.

project.title: Cleveland-Toledo-Detroit Corridor
project.about: This route would connect Ohio's densely populated northern coast to Detroit and southeastern Michigan. It could also include stops at Cleveland's and Detroit's airports.

project.title: Mountain Rail
project.about: Amtrak's seasonal ski train (the Winter Park Express) is being extended farther up the mountains to Steamboat Springs and Craig.

project.title: Downeaster Corridor
project.about: The Downeaster would receive service upgrades, an extension to Rockland, and a possible infill station in West Falmouth.

project.title: Green Mountain Corridor
project.about: This project would add a new service pattern to the Ethan Allen express, serving additional towns in Vermont en route to Burlington.

project.title: Colorado Front Range Corridor
project.about: Most of Colorado's cities lie in a straight line along the front range. A new state-supported route would connect all of them between Fort Collins and Pueblo.

project.title: Texas Triangle
project.about: As of now, there is no direct passenger rail service between Houston and the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. A new state-supported route would create this connection for the first time since 1995.

project.title: San Joaquin Valley Corridor
project.about: The Gold Runner (formerly San Joaquins) currently terminates in Sacramento and Oakland. The Sacramento branch would be extended farther north, supplementing the daily Coast Starlight between Sacramento and Redding.

project.title: Heartland Flyer Extension
project.about: The existing Heartland Flyer route would be extended north of Oklahoma City through Wichita to connect to the Southwest Chief route in Newton, Kansas.

project.title: Milwaukee - Green Bay
project.about: The Hiawatha route between Chicago and Milwaukee would be extended farther into Wisconsin to terminate in Green Bay.

project.title: Milwaukee - Madison
project.about: The Hiawatha route between Chicago and Milwaukee would be extended farther into Wisconsin to terminate in Madison where it could connect to future TCMC Borealis services.

project.title: Houston to San Antonio Corridor
project.about: A new state-supported service would supplement the three-times-per-week Sunset Limited with additional stops between Houston and San Antonio.

project.title: Coachella Valley Rail Corridor
project.about: The alignment used for two of Amtrak's long-distance routes would be served by a state-supported line with additional stations between Indio and Palm Springs.

project.title: Gulf Coast Passenger Rail
project.about: Amtrak service east of New Orleans has been suspended since Hurricane Katrina. In 2025, the Mardi Gras route restores service along part of the original route.

project.title: Jacksonville-Orlando-Miami Corridor
project.about: This project would create a state-supported route supplementing existing long-distance services between most of Florida's largest cities.

project.title: Miami-Orlando-Tampa Corridor
project.about: This project would create a state-supported route supplementing existing long-distance services between most of Florida's largest cities.

project.title: Northern Lights Express
project.about: A new state-supported route in Minnesota would connect the Twin Cities to the Twin Ports by way of Superior, Wisconsin.

project.title: Eau Claire-Twin Cities Corridor
project.about: A short regional route would connect the Twin Cities and its eastern suburbs to central Wisconsin, interlining with potential future Borealis services.

project.title: Kansas City to St. Joseph
project.about: The Missouri River Runner, connecting both sides of Missouri from St. Louis to Kansas City, would be extended north to the town of St. Joseph.

project.title: Baton Rouge-New Orleans Corridor
project.about: The alignment considered for this route last hosted passenger trains in 1969. A state-supported service would connect Louisiana's two largest cities and support future long-distance routes.

project.title: Reading-Philadelphia-New York Corridor
project.about: A new service on the Northeast Corridor would extend from New York and Philadelphia to Reading, Pennsylvania with four to eight daily round trips. The town has not seen passenger trains since 1983.

project.title: Scranton to New York Penn Station Corridor
project.about: This route would follow a branched NJ Transit commuter line through Montclair, Morristown, and Dover. The plan would rebuild tracks to Lackawanna County, enabling three daily round trips between New York and Scranton.

project.title: Commonwealth Corridor
project.about: A new route would connect Newport News and Richmond to Virginia's New River Valley. It would serve many of the same stations as the Northeast Regional as well as multiple long-distance routes.

project.title: Washington to Bristol Corridor
project.about: The Roanoke branch of the Northeast Regional would be extended farther into Virginia with a new infill station at Bedford, Virginia.

project.title: Amtrak to Long Island
project.about: A new branch of the Northeast Regional would follow Long Island Rail Road right-of-way three times a day with a connection to JFK airport.

project.title: LOSSAN Rail Corridor
project.about: The Pacific Surfliner route would be extended south of San Diego to San Ysidro on the Mexican border. This station would connect with the southern terminus of SANDAG's Blue Line trolley.

project.title: Phoenix-Tucson Corridor
project.about: A service discontinued in 1997 would be reactivated to connect Phoenix and its surrounding cities to Tucson.

project.title: Fayetteville to Raleigh Corridor
project.about: This project would rebuild a stretch of track near the North Carolina coast to connect Fyetteville to Raleigh while bringing service to small towns in between.

project.title: Wilmington to Raleigh Corridor
project.about: This project would reconstruct part of an abandoned alignment to restore service to Wilmington.

project.title: Winston-Salem to Raleigh Corridor
project.about: This route would supplement services on the Piedmont corridor between Raleigh and Charlotte with a connection to Winston-Salem.

project.title: Asheville to Salisbury Corridor
project.about: Asheville has not seen passenger rail since 1975. This proposed route would extend service to the Piedmont corridor, thereby offering connections to Charlotte and Raleigh.

project.title: Central Coast Corridor
project.about: The only connection between Southern California and the Bay Area is the once-a-day Coast Starlight route. A new service would supplement this corridor with more daily round trips.

project.title: Vermonter Corridor
project.about: The Vermonter currently terminates near the Québec border at St. Albans. This proposal would extend it to Montréal with a new customs and preclearance facility at Gare Centrale.

project.title: Diamond State Line
project.about: This route would connect downstate Delaware (including the capital of Dover) to Wilmington or Newark on the Northeast Corridor.

project.title: Wolverine Corridor
project.about: The Chicago-Detroit-Pontiac service would be rerouted through Detroit's newly reactivated Michigan Central Station, continuing across the Detroit River toward Toronto.

project.title: I-20 Corridor Intercity Passenger Rail Service
project.about: The proposed corridor would create a branch of the existing Crescent route, enabling direct service from Atlanta to Dallas-Fort Worth. The FRA's Long-Distance Study recommends this as a standalone route between those two metro areas.

project.title: Big Sky North Coast Corridor
project.about: After being discontinued in 1979, the North Coast Hiawatha could return as a parallel route to the Empire Builder between Chicago and the Pacific Northwest with stops in Montana and North Dakota's biggest population centers.

project.title: S-Line
project.about: North Carolina will soon begin construction on a higher-speed rail corridor creating a more direct route between Raleigh and the Northeast Corridor.
